svg.title: How a query flows through TripMate's files
svg.desc: User query enters main.py, goes to orchestrator.py, into the LangGraph agent node in graph.py, which calls the LLM via llm_factory.py, then routes to the tools node which calls langchain_tools.py wrapping rag_tool.py and weather_tool.py, loops back, and returns the final answer.
